message: 待ちますよ

name: Melilot
message: 「She hasn't come by today either.」

name: Synn
message: 「I... see.」
Did she go home?
Or is she still somewhere around the academy, taking photos?

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for yesterday.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel seemed to be doing well.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad... Was she eating properly?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She was eating egg sandwiches and ham sandwiches with quite an appetite.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's good...」

name: Melilot
message: 「If Azel does come by, is there any message you'd like me to pass along?」

name: Synn
message: 「Please tell her that it does have something to do with me.」

name: Synn
message: 「And... also tell her that I'm going to see her no matter what, purely for my own sake.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that all?」

name: Synn
message: 「The important things, I'll say to her in person.」

name: Melilot
message: 「He's gone home. Him.」

name: Azel
message: 「Sorry for causing you trouble.」

name: Melilot
message: 「He says it does have something to do with him.」

name: Azel
message: 「...You don't need to go out of your way to tell me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And also, 'I'm going to see Azel no matter what, purely for my own sake,' or so he says.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is all I was told to relay. However, they said they will tell you the important part in person.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You won't be able to hear it if things stay like this.」

name: Azel
message: 「I want to see him.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then why don't you go see him?」
Melilot served Azel some black tea.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm scared.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Scared?」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides... there's no point even if I do see him.」

name: Azel
message: 「Because this world will disappear in 10 days.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is quite a sudden development.」

name: Azel
message: 「...You probably don't believe me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If there are only 10 days left, does that mean there is no point in seeing him?」

name: Azel
message: 「It was a joke... There's no way this world will disappear in 10 days. Even I think that was a lame joke.」
Azel sipped her black tea as if to cover up her slip.

name: Melilot
message: 「There is also this way of thinking: precisely because there are only 10 days left, you should see him.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Over the next 10 days, if you don't see him, you will only continue to suffer, whereas if you do see him, something might change.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's why... I can't see him.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In other words, the world disappearing has nothing to do with it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Like I said, that was... a joke.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The only reason is that you are scared, isn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why are you scared?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You are afraid of him hating you, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is nothing to be surprised about. What a person fears in this kind of situation is being disliked by the other party. It is a deduction derived from general principles.」

name: Azel
message: 「D-Don't jump to conclusions.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is it already decided that Sakura-kun will dislike you?」

name: Azel
message: 「'Already decided,' you say!?」
Azel flew into a rage and stood up with enough force to nearly send the chair toppling backward.

name: Azel
message: 「It is decided! But it cannot be helped! I am, I am, I am!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You are?」
Azel sat back down in the chair weakly.

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Whenever you're ready is fine.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please tell me when you feel like talking. I'll wait.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Good evening.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you have a moment?」
